description: Creates a relationship between collections together with the schema it needs: a m2o or o2o foreign key, an o2m reverse field, a m2m junction collection, or a m2a any-collection link. Use create_field for a plain non-relational column and analyze_relationships to see what already exists. Which parameters are required depends on type: m2m needs junction_collection and both junction fields, m2a needs allowed_collections and collection_field. Creates real tables and constraints and does not roll back when a later step fails, so a half-created m2m may need manual cleanup. on_delete and on_update set the referential actions, where CASCADE means deleting a parent deletes its children.
name: create_relationship
